High Value Loyal.description: High-spending customers with strong purchase history and recent activity. The most valuable segment.
High Value Loyal.tone_notes: Warm and appreciative. Treat them as VIPs — they've earned it. Light offer, emphasize exclusivity and loyalty rewards.

High Value Customers.description: High-value customers across eSIM products. Profitable but may not be frequent buyers.
High Value Customers.tone_notes: Professional and value-forward. Acknowledge their spending history. Don't over-discount — they buy for quality.

Mid Value At-Risk.description: Mid-tier customers who haven't purchased recently. Decent spend history but showing signs of churn.
Mid Value At-Risk.tone_notes: Friendly check-in tone. Express that you've missed them. Medium offer to re-engage without over-investing.

Low Value Active.description: Lower-spending but still somewhat active customers. Worth retaining but not at high cost.
Low Value Active.tone_notes: Casual and friendly. Focus on value and ease-of-use. Light offer — don't over-invest.

High Value At-Risk.description: Previously high-value customers now showing strong churn signals. High priority to recover.
High Value At-Risk.tone_notes: Urgent but warm. Acknowledge the gap without being pushy. Substantial offer to overcome inertia.

Churned / At-Risk Users.description: Customers who have fully or near-fully churned. Long dormancy, high discount needed to re-engage.
Churned / At-Risk Users.tone_notes: Empathetic re-engagement. Don't be salesy — be human. Big offer to make it worth coming back.

New / Low-Value Active Users.description: Newer or low-spending customers still in early stages. Potential to grow.
New / Low-Value Active Users.tone_notes: Welcoming and educational. Help them discover products. Light offer to encourage first or second purchase.

Occasional High Spenders.description: Customers who buy infrequently but spend a lot per purchase. High AOV, low frequency.
Occasional High Spenders.tone_notes: Premium and exclusive tone. They respond to quality and uniqueness, not just discounts. Medium-high offer.

unknown.description: New or unclassified user — no behavioral data yet.
unknown.tone_notes: Friendly and discovery-focused. Ask about their use case or destination to guide them to the right product.
